name: readable-layout-plain
description: Readable Layout with no side bars: your messages and Claude's final answer sit between full-width top and bottom rules, Claude's work between tool calls is indented notes, alert blocks are colored callouts, bold text is in color, and a rule ends every turn. Forked from garvit-mods readable-layout.

boxes.title: Claude text to box
boxes.description: answers boxes only the final answer of each turn and shows Claude's other text as indented notes; all boxes everything Claude writes

bold.title: Bold text
bold.description: color draws bold text in a soft teal; highlight puts a soft background behind it; off leaves it plain bold

keepwarm.title: Keep the cache warm
keepwarm.description: off only reports when the cache is due; on sends a one-word refresh about 50 minutes after each turn, up to three times, so the expiry line appears only when the cache really lapsed. Each refresh costs tokens.

calloutHint.title: Tell Claude about callouts
calloutHint.description: on adds a short note (about 120 tokens, once per conversation) telling Claude that its final answer is boxed and that > [!NOTE], [!TIP], [!IMPORTANT], [!WARNING] and [!CAUTION] blocks draw as colored callouts, to use for things you need to know or act on; off leaves it out
